ev.q: Two siblings aged 5 and 15 years, experienced severe thrombocytopenia after elemental mercury vapor exposure.
Whole blood mercury concentrations for patients A and B were 315 μ g/L and 518 μ g/L
elevated whole blood mercury concentrations (range = 125–310 μ g/L [normal <10 μ g/L])
Thrombocytopenia Associated with Elemental Mercury Poisoning in Two Siblings
